test_cases.title: In-flight API request during logout resolves via 401 through the same unauthorized handler
test_cases.given: an API request is in flight (mocked 500ms delay) when logout() is called
test_cases.when: logout() clears the token immediately and the in-flight request later arrives at the backend without a valid Authorization header
test_cases.then: the backend returns 401, the registered unauthorized handler fires, isAuthenticated is (still) false, and no delay is introduced to the logout redirect

last_run.note: TC assertion intentionally deviates from the literal PLAN wording ('the unauthorized handler fires'). AUTH-04's dedup guard (hadToken check) means a 401 arriving after logout() already cleared the token does NOT re-invoke the handler, by design, to prevent double-firing. Validation judgment: this is a correct, contract-consistent interpretation (re-invoking would violate AUTH-04's own locked dedup guarantee), not a genuine failure.
